'''Traneel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''You'' there. Follow me.''"<br />"''Sir? Where to?''"<br />"''The ''aft docking bay''. The Rebels are hiding out in there.''"<br />"''But we have ''orders'' from ''Commander Traneel'' to&hellip;''"<br />"''This is a ''fluid combat'' scenario, soldier. Follow my ''orders'' or, so help me, I'll see you ''reprimanded'' by the ''Emperor'' himself.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], giving orders to a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] while wearing Traneel's uniform|<ref name="Drone Alone" />}}
[[File:Traneel_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] puts on Traneel's [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|uniform]]]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Traneel was hiding aboard [[drone vessel 171]] with several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as part of a plan devised by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. When [[Raptor Squad]] of the Rebel Alliance arrived to [[Mission to steal hyperdrive components|steal]] the [[drone freighter]], the commander came out of hiding along with his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to make them [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. However, Traneel was knocked unconscious by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who took his [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer's]] [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|uniform]] and used it to command his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />

Calrissian ordered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops to follow him to the aft [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and locked them up there. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] then used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the stormtroopers to convince them to get to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and abandon [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The Rebels captured the vessel and made their jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], presumably with Traneel still on board.<ref name="Drone Alone" />
